question.text: Kavita's equity fund earned a pre-tax return of 18%. She falls in the 30% income-tax bracket. For a transfer of equity shares/units on or after July 23, 2024, where the gain is short-term capital gain under Section 111A, what is her approximate post-tax return at the current statutory rate?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the current NISM X-A workbook (p.274), the Section 111A rate for short-term capital gains on equity has been revised to 20% for transfers on or after July 23, 2024. Post-tax return = 18% × (1 - 0.20) = 18% × 0.80 = 14.40%. The Trap: 15.30% uses the legacy 15% Section 111A rate and is no longer current. 12.60% applies the 30% slab rate, which does not apply to equity STCG. 16.20% applies a 10% rate associated with the legacy equity LTCG regime. Cross-Exam Context: NISM X-A and V-A both test post-Budget-2024 equity-STCG taxation in tax-adjusted return computations.
